components.shortDescription: Fixed outer iron core with winding slots.
components.description: The stator is the stationary part of the motor containing laminated silicon steel stacks and copper windings. It generates the rotating magnetic field when AC power is applied.

components.shortDescription: Rotating inner core with squirrel cage windings.
components.description: The rotor rotates inside the stator. This is a simple squirrel-cage design with aluminum bars shorted by end rings, creating induced currents that produce torque.
components.material: Steel core with aluminum squirrel cage

components.shortDescription: Cast aluminum outer casing with mounting feet.
components.description: The housing encloses and protects internal components. Features four M8 mounting holes for secure installation. Includes cooling fins on the exterior surface to dissipate heat from operations.

components.shortDescription: Aluminum alloy end bells supporting bearings.
components.description:
Two identical aluminum die-cast pieces that close the motor housing and support precision ball bearings for the rotor shaft. Features bearing retaining rings.

Status: Needs engineering review for bearing selection.

components.shortDescription: Hardened steel shaft with keyway for load transfer.
components.description: The main drive shaft transmits mechanical torque from the rotor to external loads. Constructed from 4130 chromemolybdenum steel, heat treated and ground for precise running fit.

components.shortDescription: Propeller fan with protective wire guard cage.
components.description: External cooling system consisting of a propeller fan mounted externally to the shaft. A 3-point steel wire mesh provides protection while maintaining adequate airflow for thermal management.

metadata.description: A simple three-phase induction AC motor assembly for industrial applications.
